# Coin98 Telegram Wallet

Source: https://docs.coin98.com/products/coin98-telegram-wallet

Last updated

At Coin98, we believe Web3 should be simple and accessible for everyone. That’s why we created the Coin98 Telegram Wallet—to bring our vision of effortless crypto interactions to life.

Telegram is already a massive platform where millions feel right at home. By integrating your wallet directly into the Telegram app, we’re making it easier for people to explore Web3. With just a few simple clicks, you can dive into the world of mini-apps on Telegram and start your crypto journey.

The idea of building the Coin98 Telegram Wallet is to turn your Telegram account into your Web3 wallet with just a few taps. By leveraging social login, your wallet is seamlessly linked to your Telegram account, allowing you to access it as easily as logging into Telegram.

The early version of the Coin98 Telegram Wallet is designed to help both crypto enthusiasts and beginners seamlessly interact with Web3. Here’s what you can do:

Manage assets across 150+ blockchains — all in one place, with more chains coming soon!

Buy tokens effortlessly with VISA, Mastercard, Google Pay, and Apple Pay.

Trade crypto assets directly within Telegram.

Transfer assets seamlessly across different networks.

Keep your assets safe in a self-custodial wallet.

Import your existing hot wallets and manage them all in one place.

There’s so much more to come!

It's quick and easy to begin. Here’s how:

Click Start to launch the Coin98 Telegram Wallet.

Click Wallet and done!

A multi-chain wallet instantly created and is linked to your Telegram account.

We’d love to hear your feedback, so give it a try and let us know what you think.

This is just the beginning! We’re continuously working to enhance your Web3 experience on Telegram. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming:

**Referral Program**: Earn potential rewards by inviting your friends to join the Web3 adventure on Telegram.

**Coin98 Telegram Wallet SDK**: A powerful toolkit to empower developers to onboard the next billion users to Web3. With this SDK, creating mini-apps that connect seamlessly to multiple blockchains and enable secure, multi-chain wallet experiences within Telegram will be easier than ever.

And that’s not all—there’s so much more on the way!

Start exploring Web3 with Coin98 today and turn your Telegram into your ultimate Web3 wallet!


Last updated

---

# Coin98 Docs

Source: https://docs.coin98.com

**Securely Built For Capital Growth**

**Securely Built For Capital Growth**

Coin98 is a secure, AI-powered financial platform for everyone to do everything onchain. Swap, trade perps, earn, spend & explore dApps across 150+ networks. Trusted by 10M+ users in 170+ countries, Coin98 makes DeFi accessible, intuitive, and secure for everyone.

Cioin98 is A Secure Financial Platform powered by AI that gives world-class access to the future of finance through an integrated one-stop suite of financial utility and trading experiences.

- **Start**- **easily**: On-ramp under 30 seconds with your local currency
- **Access**- **without**- **limit**: Trade and manage assets across multiple networks & trading options, anytime and anywhere.
- **Put**- **your money to work**: Discover diversified mini-apps for earning, yield, and opportunities beyond traditional finance.
- **Grow with confidence**: Institution-grade access to insights and research with curated content and elite communities
- **Stay protected, stay in control**: Self-custody by default, with financial insurance, 24/7 support, and AI-powered security.

Opinionated by design for financial inclusion, so those who care about their financial future can grow their money safely, without being left behind.

**Coin98 — Securely Built For Capital Growth.**

## Coin98 Universal Referral

This is more than just a referral link; it is a unified revenue-sharing model designed to turn your network into a sustainable, real-time income stream.

We have unified the entire ecosystem into a single system designed for speed and growth.

- **One Link for Everything:**A single link covers Futures, SwapX (coming soon), and Fusion Card, creating multiple real-time income streams at once.
- **Zero Friction:**Codes are auto-applied instantly on any device. Your network syncs across Web and Mobile, so you never miss a reward.
- **Dual-Layer Earnings:**Earn passive income not just from your direct friends, but also from the friends they invite.
- **Faster Growth:**Activity in any feature boosts your total XP, helping you level up quickly to unlock maximum commission rates.

To maximize your benefits, it’s important to understand the simple difference between Ranking (XP) and Revenue (Commissions). Think of it like a game: XP helps you level up, while Commissions are the real money you take.

Your XP and Commissions are fueled directly by your network's activity. Every time your invitees generate fees through eligible actions, you earn rewards.

Currently, the activities that count towards your growth include:

- **Futures Trading:**When your invitees trade on Coin98 Futures.
- **Fusion Card:**When they top up their Coin98 Fusion Card.
- **SwapX:**When they swap on SwapX (coming soon)

At this moment, we are still heading down for the building. Eventually, the community will figure out a better picture for all the DeFi stacks we are nurturing.

DeFi is the century's innovation, which will undoubtedly change how global finance works in the future. Coin98 is proud to be a special part of the journey of making DeFi accessible to everyone, regardless of their knowledge and familiarity with blockchain.

# Developer Guide

Source: https://docs.coin98.com/developer-guide

Last updated

**Coin98 Adapter** is built to make the integration between your Multi-chain Dapp and Wallet easier than ever. Powered by Coin98 Multi-chain core engine, Coin98 Adapter can handle the connection and functions for most of the popular Blockchains and Wallets on the market.

**Coin98 Adapter** provides an easy connect modal UI with Light/Dark mode available to choose. For more advanced use cases, you can use your owned dapp connection UI and call the supported Adapter functions instead. 

Coin98 Adapter currently supports most of the popular EVM Chains, more Chains and Wallets will be supported in the future.

# C98 Token

Source: https://docs.coin98.com/products/coin98-token

**What is Coin98 Token (C98 Token)?**

C98 Token is the native utility token of the Coin98 DeFi platform, powering the entire ecosystem. C98 tokens are built on Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain (BSC), Solana, Polygon and Viction.

**Coin98 Token Use Cases**

**Coin98 Token Use Cases**

Coin98 Token (C98 Token) plays an important role in operating the Coin98 ecosystem, and at the same time brings profits to holders and rights for long-term development.

#### Staking Incentives

For Coin98 Exchange to function well, it is critical to incentivize users to play the role of liquidity providers and stake their digital assets into the decentralized market-making pools. As compensation for opportunity costs, by providing liquidity, or participating in liquidity mining across the various Coin98 staking options and platforms, users can earn a passive income by locking up funds and receiving C98 tokens in return.

### Governance

To promote decentralized community governance for the network, C98 token holders may propose and vote on governance proposals to determine features and/or parameters of the Coin98 Exchange and its products. By participating in the platform’s governance model, users can commit C98 tokens to vote on new features and changes to various protocol parameters throughout the Coin98 crypto network.

For the avoidance of doubt, the right to vote is restricted solely to voting on features of the Coin98 Exchange; the right to vote does not entitle C98 token holders to vote on the operation and management of the Company, its affiliates, or their assets or the disposition of such assets to token holders, and does not constitute any equity interest in any of these entities. The arrangement is not intended to be any form of joint venture or partnership.

### Unique Membership Rights

C98 Token holders are arranged into a tiered system that provides access to exclusive privileges and premium events, based on the amount of C98 held. Users in higher tiers will gain exclusive access to premium events and privileges, such as priority for Coin98 launchpad participation and marketing events with strategic partners.

### Product Development and Growth

Furthermore, the C98 token will be used to create a “self-sustainable, closed-loop economy” through the collection of network fees, whether in C98 or otherwise, would be re-distributed as incentives for active contributors within the ecosystem, or set aside for future product development and ecosystem growth.

**C98 Token Metrics**

**C98 Token Release Schedule**

**C98 Token Release Schedule**

Ecosystem Growth

4 years vesting, 30% release at TGE (Token Generation Event), linear unlock starting from the 2nd year

Community Development

4 years vesting, 30% release at TGE (Token Generation Event), linear unlock starting from the 2nd year

Team

4 years vesting, 1 year cliff, linear unlock starting from the 2nd year.

Strategic Sale

2 years vesting, 1 year cliff, linear unlock starting from the 2nd year.

Treasury

4 years vesting, 10% release at TGE (Token Generation Event), 1 year cliff, linear unlock starting from the 2nd year.

Seed Sale

3 years vesting, 1 year cliff, linear unlock starting from the 2nd year.

Binance Launchpad Sale

100% release at TGE

Advisors

3 years vesting, 1 year cliff, linear unlock starting from the 2nd year
